interpretation: The byte budget is an empirical scheduling heuristic. Runtime output equivalence and performance must be reviewed; this manifest does not authorize promotion or prove benefit.

memory.scope: whole process including setup, indexing, checks and all cases; not per-query memory

mode.normalization_check: Every source row claimed plain byte length is checked using public normalize_text_for_indexing during untimed setup.
mode.vocalized_preflight: plain query שלום; match_nikud=false; public set_vocalized_snippets(true) while searching, RAII restoration to false; retains both texts in LibraryDb and InIndex

snapshot_schema.container: JSON array of result objects followed by newline

status: Frozen fixture source and declared interface; remote compilation and execution remain pending.

timing.original_concurrent_workload: The original unchanged indexing_throughput fixture is a separate executable and retains its concurrent-indexing workload.
timing.p99_resolution: With 30 observations p99 is the sample maximum, not a stable tail estimate.
timing.scope: full public search_exact after completed indexing; query argument construction and unwrap included; result consumption/drop, validation and serialization excluded
timing.validation: Every standard page is compared with the full ordered result snapshot before timing; each timed page is compared once more after timing outside the timer. Controller compares all full snapshot bytes across H/E, processes and topologies.
